title: [Expense tests] Re-enable reviewed APIs and consolidate Expense fixes
summary: Expense Agent API tests are re-enabled. Eleven Expense API and helper paths move to shared authentication, 51 Expense API exclusions are removed, and nine non-API exclusions stay. Clean test codeunit execution is turned on, and 193 temporary API exclusions are added to the existing APIV1 and APIV2 manifests.
key_points: Migrated 11 Expense API and helper paths to shared authentication
Removed 51 Expense API test exclusions; kept 9 non-API Expense exclusions
Enabled the existing enableCleanTestCodeunitExecution setting using existing DisabledTests selectors
Added 193 temporary method-specific exclusions to the existing APIV1 and APIV2 manifests, to be removed in a follow-up PR
Consolidated test fixes for policy URL composition, response isolation, assigned-user filtering and denied-approval handling
quote: Migrate the 11 reviewed Expense API/helper paths to shared authentication and remove exactly 51 existing Expense API exclusions.
